MJ6.title: Monocoque: the fairing is the structure

clasp_bracket.note: clasp feet to the shell's lower edge (the via node is moulded into the shell)

balancer.home: flat spiral spring + cam drum inside the shell (NEW balancer type, not designed)
balancer.verdict: fits the shell depth, but a cam-drum spiral balancer that reproduces the zero-length cord law over both axes is not designed (PLACEHOLDER)

MJ11.title: Blade-seated pancake: flat pad on a conformal foam dish, bolted to the rail
MJ11.clasp: feet to the pad's top rim

pad.note: R66 x 6 PA-CF pad disc trimmed flat at y -121 (spine-bridge ears), S1' AK70 on its rear face (flange PLACEHOLDER); its flat front face lies on the seat dish and, medially, on the rail spacers

seat_dish.note: conformal PA-CF shell: outer face the flat plane x0, inner face the skin + 8 mm liner; variable thickness 3.0..65.4 mm (drawn solid, mass at the hollow fill 0.30: 2.4 mm walls + ribs); prints flat face down, no supports

liner.note: 8 mm closed-cell foam (0.12 g/cm3 assumed) + PTFE-fabric slip face toward the plate side of the base layer; 3 radial lead channels 8 mm wide (psi 225/270/315)

rail_spacers.note: 4 spacers D10 from the rail rear face to the pad plane (4.8..8.3 mm), M4 x 20 SHCS into new M4 heat-set inserts (5.6 OD x 4) in the rail (PLACEHOLDER bosses)

clasp_bracket.note: clasp feet (re-seated) to the pad rim at psi 119, anchor r 66, hub bar 24 x 6, overhang 6

fairing.note: fixed fairing: 1.8 mm PA-CF C-shell on the pad rear face (outline = pad R66 trimmed y -121, flush with pad and dish), x XB..XO+31, closed end plate, swept slot for the S1' yoke bar / S2 clamp (gap 3.2), gland bore R6.6 at psi 190, 3 tabs M3 x 5 into the pad (inserts PLACEHOLDER); prints end plate down, no supports

balancer.verdict: no balancer: shoulder motors carry the full gravity torque (SF 1.14 vs rated at the worst pose, gate waiver needed)
